source.cache_policy: source terms require cache refresh within 24 hours

geography.matching_rule: exact normalized province name; no nearest-city or historical merge inference

taxonomy.mapping_note: API codes are preserved verbatim. The C-prefix maps to manufacturing, while division mappings remain provisional until the API's underlying VSIC revision is verified.

indicators.method: sum API total values for disjoint target prefixes within a track; no company records are downloaded for aggregate counts
limitations: Registered activity is not proof of current production or machine purchasing intent.
Counts are not an official NSO statistic until reconciled against NSO tables.
A source failure or missing prefix leaves the track value null.

indicators.unit: active registered enterprises per population or total enterprises
indicators.method: not computed in this phase; requires a same-period denominator
